verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents routing by conditions: escalation rules can use time, team availability and incident origin, and incidents can be routed to the right responder using catalog metadata. Ingestion of alerts from external monitoring tools rests only on a marketing line naming Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana and others, with no integration documentation in the pack. Missing for 10: documented per-source alert ingestion guides (e.g., Datadog/Prometheus webhook setup), detailed routing-rule documentation tying ingested alerts to specific teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, alerts from my monitoring tools are ingested through documented sources and routed to the right team by conditions I define

citations.quote: Plug in the services you already use including Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Azure, AWS & Google Cloud.
Configure complex rules for escalating incidents based on time, team availability, and incident origin.
Route the incident to the right responder.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
